shared_elements: shallow low-relief carving on a large upright stone slab/pillar
rectangular framed panel / raised border enclosing a motif
small pendant or hanging object rendered in relief
surrounding dry-stone rubble walling and excavated earth
justification: Both show a tall upright limestone slab, set in rubble walling, carved in the same shallow, flattened low relief with an animal shown in profile inside a raised rectangular frame — the framed motif on B's broad face is the most specific echo of the framed registers on A. The decisive difference is density and organisation: A is packed with stacked registers (arches, a banded net pattern, quadruped, human-like figure, large bird) filling the whole surface, whereas B carries a single small isolated motif on an otherwise blank face, so the compositional schemes do not correspond.
